title: Hardcoded UUID violations (T010) across 100+ integration test files
notes: Cluster J (lint cluster) from Step 5c verification. lint_test_isolation.py reports 258 MAJOR T010 'hardcoded UUID' findings across 100+ integration test files. The 118-file check returned BLOCKER=0 MAJOR=258 MINOR=0 with 195 issues already suppressed from baseline. Examples: tests/integration/adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig:150 (`00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000123`), iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig:189..1444 (12 occurrences of `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099`), iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig:79..248 (multiple `e02050xx-...` literals), obs05_dlq_test.zig:191..405 (mixed `aaaaaaaa-...`, `00000000-...`, `11111111-...` literals), svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig:94..624 (mixed literals), svc03_definition_activation_scope_test.zig:199..484, svc04_admin_api_test.zig:205..753. Per INV-TI-3 and the integration test isolation guide, ALL test fixtures must use per-test UUIDs (e.g. via a randomSeed-* helper or std.crypto.random to avoid deterministic collisions across runs). Also surfaces a T020 finding (module-level mutable var `dummy_ctx_byte` in tests/integration/onboarding_realm_guard_test.zig:103) and a T050 finding (tests/integration/svc02_plugin_dispatch_scope_test.zig does not reference BPM_TEST_DB_URL). Evidence: scratch/WF03-gh375-20260801/test-runner-step5c/lint.log. RESOLVED-PARTIAL: 17 of 20 affected files remain. Follow-up branch recommended for incremental migration.

root_cause.details: Integration tests inserted fixed UUID literals (e.g. `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000099`, `e02050xx-*`, `aaaaaaaa-...`) directly into INSERT statements rather than generating per-test UUIDs. When two or more tests reuse the same UUID under concurrent or sequential execution in the same db_test container, the second INSERT collides via unique-constraint 23505 or overwrites prior data, leading to test contamination and brittle isolation. The lint baseline (tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json) suppresses 195 of these but the remaining 258 active MAJOR findings still represent a substantial risk surface for future test runs.

candidate_resolution: Centralize per-test UUID generation in tests/integration/helpers.zig (e.g. `fn newUuid() std.uuid.Uuid` using std.crypto.random or a deterministic seed counter under test control), replace all hardcoded UUID literals across the affected test files with calls to that helper, and enforce the rule via lint_test_isolation.py to fail BUILD on any new T010 finding.
prevention: Promote T010 from MAJOR to BLOCKER in lint_test_isolation.py once a sufficient migration window has elapsed.
Add a per-test UUID helper in tests/integration/helpers.zig and migrate existing tests incrementally.
Refresh tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json only after fixes land, never to mask new violations.
